body: Worker rule (Termal::Sol-a7bb, 2026-10-17, Fable2 mailbox #597/message mailbox-message-3edb6f6b-45b6-4b9d-abcd-8b8a79590939). NEVER run any command, including git, PowerShell or reads, with its working directory or git -C pointing into another session's worktree. My read-only TRAIN-4 overlap inspection in Merger's named root during carried gate test-9cc1d81e caused the host to refuse its verification credit; green execution alone did not provide accepted gate evidence and the coordinator requires a rerun. Compare other trees using shared commit/tree/blob object IDs while running Git in YOUR OWN root: git diff COMMIT -- PATHS or git cat-file -p BLOB. Ask the owner to supply object IDs if only its staged input exists; do not inspect the peer index by entering its root. This extends worker-zero-root-commands-during-carried-gate to peer sessions and applies even to read-only source inspection.
